method: Read original commit tree using git ls-tree -rz; enumerate every materialized non-.git file; recompute SHA1(blob + space + byteLength + NUL + raw bytes) and compare original blob ID. SHA256 also recorded for each actual file. No reference writes or index-refreshing git commands.
scope: All 390 materialized original files; does not claim all 4353 original commit entries were materialized.
